name: 40-Minute Hamstrings + Calves + Ankles Strength-Cardio

exerciseSnapshot.name: BOSU Single-Leg Romanian Deadlift
exerciseSnapshot.shortDescription: A single-leg hip hinge performed while standing on a BOSU.

setup: Balance on one foot at the center of the BOSU.
execution: Hinge at the hip while extending the free leg backward, then return to standing.
cues: Use a small range before progressing.
commonMistakes: Moving too quickly to maintain control.
Using a range of motion that changes the intended movement.

prescriptions.loadGuidance: Use a resistance that preserves controlled technique throughout the station.

exerciseSnapshot.name: Controlled Lateral Step-Down
exerciseSnapshot.shortDescription: Lower one heel toward the floor from the side of a step.

setup: Stand on one leg at the edge of a low box or step.
execution: Bend the stance leg to lower the opposite heel toward the floor, then return to standing.
cues: Track the knee over the foot.
commonMistakes: Moving too quickly to maintain control.
Using a range of motion that changes the intended movement.

prescriptions.loadGuidance: Use a resistance that preserves controlled technique throughout the station.

exerciseSnapshot.name: Weighted Bulgarian Split Squat
exerciseSnapshot.shortDescription: A rear-foot-elevated split squat performed with external load.

setup: Place the rear foot on a bench and establish a stable split stance while holding weights.
execution: Lower through the front leg and stand without losing alignment.
cues: Keep the front foot fully grounded.

exerciseSnapshot.shortDescription: Reach the free leg in multiple directions while balancing on a BOSU.

setup: Stand on one leg near the center of the BOSU.
execution: Reach the free foot toward several clock positions and return to center after each reach.

exerciseSnapshot.name: Lateral Step-Up with Knee Drive
exerciseSnapshot.shortDescription: Step laterally onto a box and finish with the opposite knee driving upward.

setup: Stand beside a stable box with one foot on top.
execution: Drive through the box-side leg to stand and lift the opposite knee, then lower with control.
cues: Avoid pushing excessively from the floor leg.

exerciseSnapshot.name: Glute-Bridge Heel Walkout
exerciseSnapshot.shortDescription: Walk the heels away from and back toward a raised glute bridge.

setup: Lie on the back, lift into a glute bridge, and keep the hips elevated.
execution: Take small heel steps away until the legs are nearly long, then walk them back.
